tool.name: Cowpy ASCII-art message
tool.description: Render a text message as an ASCII-art cow speech bubble with cowpy

param.name: message
param.label: Message
param.help: Text the cow says. Defaults to the nf-core/demo message.

tool.help: Pipes a message through cowpy (1.1.5) and writes the ASCII-art cow to a text file. Ported from the nf-core/demo COWPY local module (echo "nf-core rules!" | cowpy > cowpy.txt).
